## Session Context (Overte MCP)

You have access to an Overte VR/metaverse MCP server (3 tools: overte_domain_status, overte_entity_spawn, overte_script_inject) plus a React dashboard.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check domain-server status: overte_domain_status(host="localhost", port=40100)
2. Load the WebSocket bridge in Overte Interface for live spawn/inject tools

**At end of work:**
- Verify entity spawns and script injections against the live domain
